needs_coordinates.name: Hulhumalé Phase 1 parking building (NXT by Batch)
needs_coordinates.source: President's Office, 29 Mar 2026; MMTV (over 800 four-wheelers, over 500 two-wheelers)
needs_coordinates.notes: 13 storeys plus basement, works started; first of 7 planned buildings. The Standard reported 600+ cars, the official sources say 800+.

needs_coordinates.name: Hulhumalé Phase 2 temporary parking zones
needs_coordinates.notes: Sources disagree: four zones totalling 1,200 (Edition, names only Hiyaa Tower 16) or one zone of 1,200+ next to the Cat Shelter (PSM). Count once; split into zones when known.

needs_coordinates.name: HDC pocket parking (8 zones)
needs_coordinates.notes: 1,374 car-size slots leased. Zone locations are in HDC's announcement PDFs. May overlap the report's road-side slots: enter each zone separately when known.
